trail.name: Inspiration Point via Round-trip Shuttle
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS West Shore Boat Dock marker, approximately 49 m from the USGS land-trail endpoint. Area forecast reference for the walking start after the crossing; not navigation or uniform conditions at the viewpoint.
trail.planningNote: NPS gives a page-wide 2–4 hour range, not a shuttle-specific time guarantee. Allow extra time for boat travel, queues and parking-to-dock access.

accessRoute.label: Round-trip shuttle + hike
accessRoute.start: East Shore Boat Dock for the crossing; hike from West Shore Boat Dock
accessRoute.returnPlan: Hike back to the west dock, then take the return boat to the east dock.
accessRoute.distanceScope: West-dock hiking out and back. Boat crossings and parking-to-dock access are not included.

comparison.summary: Comparable public route using the Jenny Lake shuttle and the west-dock hike to Inspiration Point. NPS values remain authoritative when public metrics differ.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS shuttle map, distinct from the South Jenny Lake walking approach. Its old CARTO line service is unavailable; the USGS comparison follows the connected west-dock/Hidden Falls corridor, not a claimed exact reconstruction of that unavailable layer.

comparison.note: Connected USGS west-dock land junction to Hidden Falls spur and Inspiration Point, returning on the same corridor: approximately 1.852 mi versus NPS 1.8 mi. The mapped land trail stops about 49 m short of the NPS dock marker; that dock connector and boat travel are not measured. This is a corridor comparison, not a navigation track or an exact recreation of the unavailable NPS CARTO layer.

photo.alt: Hikers walk up a rocky trail with a cliff on the right.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied. Original sharpness reviewed without upscaling.
